notes: Chunk 102: 6 pages, 7 snapshot text files, all Common Crawl captures (sourceUrl = index lookup address; sourceDate = capture date); no live copies were supplied. All 7 files were readable. (1) Weatherhead DSS alumni page: the same URL shows only one class at a time; the 2020-09-21 capture shows "Class of 2020" (4 people) and the 2021-09-25 capture shows "Class of 2021" (3 people); classes 2012-2019 are linked but not captured. yearMeaning is class-of, not a verified graduation year. The DSS track is the PhD-in-Management track for practitioner doctorates; dissertation topics are not operations. (2) CityU Scholars: single-person student-thesis record for WANG Haolin (name copied with the Chinese form as on the page); the page labels the year "Award year" (thesis dated 30 Jul 2018) and the degree is recorded as the thesis type "Doctoral Thesis"; no department is stated for the thesis. (3) Clemson TigerPrints Management and Information Systems series: a single 2009 dissertation (Ravi Narayanaswamy); degree not named; the year heading "Dissertations from 2009" is recorded as unstated. (4) Columbia Job Market Candidates (2021-09-24 capture): only two candidates appear (Finance and Marketing); the Accounting, Decision Risk and Operations, Economics and Management headings carry no names in this capture, so the DRO job-market list for that year is not recoverable from this file; no year is printed, so listedYear is null. (5) Columbia Dissertations year=2019: 9 dissertations with advisors; the page does not state the division per person (recorded program as "Doctoral Program"), nor the degree name, and "2019" is the dissertation-page year (recorded as unstated). Only Francisco Castro (advisor Omar Besbes) is an operations dissertation; the others are management, marketing, accounting and finance. (6) HEC Paris news item: 9 named 2019 PhD graduates with departments in parentheses; the list ends with "......" and may be incomplete; only Ali Shantia is in Information Systems and Operations Management. No master’s graduates appear on any page.
